name: promptprinter
//engines: One Node major for everything we test and ship (audit M8, 06.10.2026):
this field, .nvmrc, the setup-node steps (they read .nvmrc), the Dockerfile and
@types/node. Vercel reads `engines.node` and it OVERRIDES the project setting,
so this line is what production runs. tests/guards/node-version.test.ts fails
when any of them drifts. To change the major, see docs/SETUP.md, "Node-Version".
//overrides: Security-Audit finding H-2. Each entry is the MINIMAL in-range bump that
clears a published advisory for a transitive dependency whose own parent
still pins a vulnerable version. No majors, no downgrades — npm's own
`audit fix` proposal for this tree was `next@9.3.3`, i.e. a five-year
downgrade, which is why these are pinned by hand instead.
Re-check on every dependency bump: an override that outlives its advisory
is just an unexplained version pin. `npm audit` in CI is what catches that.
postcss is ALSO a direct devDependency, so its override is `$postcss` (npm:
"use the direct dependency's own range") and not a copy of the range. A copy
makes npm fail with EOVERRIDE the moment Dependabot raises the direct entry
(06.10.2026: its group refresh failed with "Override for postcss@8.5.28

scripts.docker:dev: node scripts/check-env.mjs dev && docker compose up --build
scripts.docker:prod: node scripts/check-env.mjs prod && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file .env.local up --build -d
